transcript: Your small business answers the same questions every day. What if you explained it well once, and a video kept doing the job for you?
Every small business fields the same questions daily. A short video answers each one the same way, without anyone on your team stopping what they're doing.
Video shows the steps while it explains them. It works when you're offline, keeps every detail accurate and on brand, and captions help more people understand.
Pick the spot where a clear explanation would change what people do. That might be your homepage, a welcome email, or the follow-up after a first call.
Use situation, problem, answer, proof, next step. For a local bookkeeper, that's five slides, a sentence or two each, and about a minute of video.
Start with the deck you already have. On Pro, AI directs the video, so it looks produced without an agency. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
